references.text: Zebulun received his allotted inheritance here, including the cities mentioned in Judges 1:30
Benjamin also did not drive out the Jebusites from Jerusalem, a parallel example of the tribes failing to complete the conquest
Manasseh also did not drive out the Canaanites but forced them into labor, following the same pattern as Zebulun
Ephraim also did not drive out the Canaanites from Gezer, another example of incomplete conquest just before this verse
Naphtali also did not drive out the inhabitants but forced them into labor, following the same pattern as Zebulun
When the Israelites became strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor instead of driving them out
